'''Eevee... Pokémon Genius!''' (Japanese: '''天才ポケモン イーブイくん''' ''The Genius Pokémon {{tt|Eievui|Eevee}}-kun'') is the ninth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
As [[Hazel]] and [[Grandpa]] are talking, a strange girl walks in the room with her Pokémon, {{TP|Coconut|Eevee}}, and [[Almond]]. This girl reveals herself as [[Coconut]], Grandpa's biological granddaughter. Hazel and Coconut begin to argue about whom should be with Almond, leading Coconut to set a challenge. They decide that they will both get chocolates for Almond - and the first girl he gives candy to in return will be the one who gets to "keep him".

Later, Hazel worries that Coconut might try to sneak a love potion into the chocolate she gives Almond. She asks {{MPJ|Pikachu}} and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} to spy on her and report back anything they see.

Meanwhile, at Grandpa's house, Coconut is indeed trying to concoct a love potion. However, she constantly makes mistakes, causing many small fires and explosions. After destroying the laboratory, she ends up giving Almond store-bought chocolates instead. Before he can receive them, however, {{MPJ|Squirtle}} intercepts and eats them instead.

==Major events==
* [[Coconut]] and {{TP|Coconut|Eevee}} are introduced.
* [[Hazel]] and Coconut become [[rival]]s.
{{endspoilers}}
